notes.title: KARM UPDATE 0.8.6
notes.content:
Hello,


[list]
[*] Too many modifications and bug fixes have been made since the last update, and I can't really list them all here.
[*] The game now uses the Unreal Engine 5 and the first episode has been  entirely remade.
[*] You may experience issues with savegames until the official 1.0.0 release.
[*] I'm now investigating on DX11/12 compatibilities, Tell me if you have any issues with DX11 system.
[*] I'm working hard on the episode 2 with no budget and if you want to support the development you can do it here: [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/ormusto]https://www.buymeacoffee.com/ormusto[/url]
[/list]


___
Have fun!

- YOUR SAVEGAMES MAY CONTAIN WRONG DATAS (AND SHOULD BE DELETED) AFTER THIS UPDATE -
